summarization: This smartphone UI screen is a permission request from the app "myMail." The app is asking for permission to know the user's age range and language. The request is presented under the user's Google account information, which is displayed at the top of the screen. The user has two options at the bottom of the screen: "DENY" or "ALLOW" to either refuse or grant the requested permission. The text also mentions that by continuing, the user allows the app and Google to use their information in accordance with their respective terms of service and privacy policies.
